{
  "name": "bus_read_rom_info",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Reads a fixed 320-byte bus ROM block, validates its magic number, and copies selected information fields requested by a bit mask into the caller buffer while checking the destination size.",
  "subsystem": "hal",
  "var_renames": {
    "a1": "field_mask",
    "a2": "dest",
    "a3": "dest_len",
    "v6": "copied_len"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 0, "meaning": "ROM block magic number"},
    {"offset": 4, "meaning": "ROM block flags / field availability mask"},
    {"offset": 20, "meaning": "6-byte identifier field selected by BIT(1) in the request mask"},
    {"offset": 292, "meaning": "2-byte information field selected by BIT(20) in the request mask"},
    {"offset": 296, "meaning": "8-byte information field selected by BIT(21) in the request mask"},
    {"offset": 304, "meaning": "4-byte information field selected by BIT(22) in the request mask"},
    {"offset": 308, "meaning": "2-byte information field selected by BIT(23) in the request mask"},
    {"offset": 310, "meaning": "10-byte information field selected by BIT(24) in the request mask"}
  ]
}
